guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: SBR在同一槽以時間切換進水、反應、沉澱與排水。學徒建立兩槽排程及事件紀錄，檢查每次切換前條件，而非只按固定計時器。
guides.conceptEn: An SBR sequences filling, reaction, settling and decant in one basin. Build a two-basin schedule and event log, checking transition conditions rather than relying only on a timer.
procedure: 先點選「每批污染質量輸入」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「兩批之間進水緩衝」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「雙槽週期與日能力」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把週期改成8 h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1200 m³/d。與基準 1600 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「反應期有效水量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「曝氣階段供氧」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「氨轉化與週期終點」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「缺氧階段電子供體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把硝酸氮改成25 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 71.5 kg COD/d。與基準 57.2 kg COD/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「沉澱後排水介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把排水Q改成80 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.4 m/h。與基準 0.6 m/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「曝氣時間與日耗電」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把每天曝氣時數改成15 h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 300 kWh/d。與基準 240 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「跨批次排泥與菌齡」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10 d。與基準 12 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the per-batch pollutant input measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the interbatch influent buffer measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the two-basin cycles/daily capacity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only cycle time to8 h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1200 m³/d. Compare with baseline 1600 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the reaction-period effective volume measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the aerated-phase oxygen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the anoxic-phase donor measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only nitrate nitrogen to25 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 71.5 kg COD/d. Compare with baseline 57.2 kg COD/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the post-settling decant interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only decantQ to80 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.4 m/h. Compare with baseline 0.6 m/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the aeration time/daily energy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only aerated time to15 h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 300 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 240 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the cross-cycle wasting/solids age measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10 d. Compare with baseline 12 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「每批污染質量輸入」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「兩批之間進水緩衝」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
在時間軸排列兩槽狀態，查進水高峰時是否仍有接收容積。在離線場景為「雙槽週期與日能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「反應期有效水量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「曝氣階段供氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「氨轉化與週期終點」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「缺氧階段電子供體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
重播液位與泥層高度，檢查排水末段濁度。在離線場景為「沉澱後排水介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
在週期圖分開記錄曝氣、攪拌、沉澱的電表與狀態。在離線場景為「曝氣時間與日耗電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「跨批次排泥與菌齡」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for per-batch pollutant input; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for interbatch influent buffer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Schedule both tanks on a timeline and check receiving capacity during influent peaks. Build an offline evidence table for two-basin cycles/daily capacity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for reaction-period effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for aerated-phase oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for anoxic-phase donor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Replay liquid and blanket levels and inspect late-decant turbidity. Build an offline evidence table for post-settling decant interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Log power and states separately for aeration, mixing and settling on the cycle timeline. Build an offline evidence table for aeration time/daily energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for cross-cycle wasting/solids age; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只縮短沉澱以增加批次可能使污泥隨排水流失。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
泥層上浮或液位感測錯誤可使排水器吸入污泥。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
沉澱時曝氣誤開會破壞分離，不只多耗電。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Shortening settling solely to add batches may wash out solids during decant. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Rising sludge or level-sensor error can make a decanter entrain solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Accidental aeration during settling disrupts separation as well as wasting energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

history.text: EPA序批式反應槽資料說明以批次週期整合反應與沉澱；本課將其轉為可追蹤的教學狀態，不提供實廠自動控制程式。地圖僅標示方法資料來源機構EPA總部的區域參考點，不表示此處設有本課處理廠。
history.textEn: EPA describes batch-cycle integration of reaction and settling; this lesson turns it into traceable educational states rather than live plant-control code. The map marks the EPA headquarters area as a method-source institution, not a treatment plant for this lesson.

courses.connection: SBR在同一槽以時間切換進水、反應、沉澱與排水。學徒建立兩槽排程及事件紀錄，檢查每次切換前條件，而非只按固定計時器。
courses.connectionEn: An SBR sequences filling, reaction, settling and decant in one basin. Build a two-basin schedule and event log, checking transition conditions rather than relying only on a timer.
